Had some down time at the lab today and started playing some MLP inspired flash games. Thought I'd share a few. These are all by the same developer, futzi01 on Deviant Art.

Canterlot Defender: As Twilight shoot the changelings with magic before they leave the screen. You can call on the other mane 5 as power ups. No time limit. Game ends when too many changelings make it through.

Pinkie Jump: See how high Pinkie can climb using clouds as trampolines. The clouds disappear after one hit. Don't fall. No Time Limit.

Dash: Side scroller. You play as Rainbow Dash and you're in a time trial race. You constantly gain speed until you reach Sonic Rainboom speeds. Hitting clouds slows you down. Try and get the fastest time to the finish line.

Canterlot Siege 1, 2 and 3: Tower Defense. First game uses the Mane 6 as your towers. Second game uses some secondary characters and the third uses villains.

Elemental Reaction: Click elements to start a chain reaction. Finish in the fewest clicks possible.
